roots.origin: 拉丁语 colere（耕作、住下来照管），过去分词 cultus；colonus 是「垦地定居的人」，cultura 是「照管出来的东西」
roots.core_concept: settling on ground and tending it until it yields / 在一处住下、照管到它长出东西
roots.core_image: 一块生地被人年年翻整，几季之后垄上长出成片的苗

roots.origin: 拉丁语 creare（使生出、造出），与 crescere（生长）同源而分工：creare 是「使之生出」，crescere 是「自己长大」
roots.core_concept: bringing into being what was not there / 把原先没有的弄出来
roots.core_image: 空空的台面上，手一撤，那件东西就摆在那儿了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 crux（属格 crucis：十字架、交叉的木架）；两根木条交叉的那个点，是这一族的共同意象
roots.core_concept: two lines meeting at one crossing point / 两条线交在一点上
roots.core_image: 两根木条叠成十字，钉在交叉那一点上

roots.origin: 拉丁语 dare（给），过去分词 datus，中性 datum 表「所给之物」。库中已有的 edere-publish（ex＋dare 交出）与 tradere（trans＋dare 交付）是含 dare 的复合动词，各自建模在先；本根是被复合的本体，三者同源分支不同
roots.core_concept: putting a thing into another's hands / 把东西交到别人手上
roots.core_image: 手一伸，东西从这边转到那边的手里

roots.origin: 希腊语 kamara（拱顶）→ 拉丁语 camera（拱顶的小室）；词根 id 取希腊词形 kamara，因 camera 本身是本批要收的单词，作 id 会产生自环边；暗箱成像的器械因是「暗室」而得名 camera obscura，遂简称 camera
roots.core_concept: a small closed room, and what happens inside it / 一间关起来的小屋，及屋里发生的事
roots.core_image: 一间没有窗的小屋，门一关，里外就隔断了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 damnum（损失、罚金），动词 damnare 表「判罚、使受损」；经古法语 damage、damner 分支入英语
roots.core_concept: loss inflicted, and the judgement that inflicts it / 加在人身上的损失，及判它的那道裁断
roots.core_image: 账上被划掉一笔，那笔就再也回不来了

concepts.concept: settling on ground and tending it until it yields
concepts.core_image: 生地被人年年翻整，几季后垄上长出成片的苗

concepts.concept: bringing into being what was not there
concepts.core_image: 空台面上手一撤，那件东西就摆在那儿了

concepts.concept: two lines meeting at one crossing point
concepts.core_image: 两根木条叠成十字，钉在交叉那一点上

concepts.concept: putting a thing into another's hands
concepts.core_image: 手一伸，东西从这边转到那边的手里

concepts.concept: a small closed room, and what happens inside it
concepts.core_image: 没有窗的小屋，门一关，里外就隔断了

concepts.concept: loss inflicted, and the judgement that inflicts it
concepts.core_image: 账上被划掉一笔，那笔再也回不来了

words.root_logic: colonus（垦地定居者）+ -y → 一群人迁去垦住的那片地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 colonia（垦殖地）← colonus（垦地定居的人）← colere（耕作、住下）
words.native_definition: a country or area controlled by another; a group of the same kind living together
words.core_concept: ground a group moved onto and settled, still answering to where they came from – 一群人迁去住下、却仍听原处号令的那片地
words.core_image: 船靠岸后那批人就地搭屋开垦，账目还往老家报
examples: The colony gained independence in 1960.
A colony of ants lives under the step.
semantic_expansions: 殖民地：迁去垦住、仍受原处管辖的那片地
聚居地/群体：同类生物聚在一处住下的那一片
words.recall_hint: colonus（垦地定居者）→ 一群人迁去垦住的地方

words.root_logic: colony（垦殖地）+ -al（…的）→ 属于殖民地那一套的
words.origin: 英语 colonial，来自 colony ← 拉丁语 colonia ← colere
words.native_definition: relating to a colony or to the period of colonial rule
words.core_concept: belonging to the arrangement where one land is worked for another – 属于「一地被另一地经营」那套安排
words.core_image: 旧账本上写着每季运回去多少，签的是本地人的名
examples: The building dates from colonial times.
They opposed colonial rule.
semantic_expansions: 殖民的/殖民地的：属于「一地被另一地经营」那套安排
words.recall_hint: colony（垦殖地）+ -al → 属于那套安排的

words.root_logic: cult（照管）+ -ure → 照管出来的那一片 → 耕作，引申为世代养出的风习
words.origin: 拉丁语 cultura（耕作、照管）← colere（耕作、住下照管）
words.native_definition: the customs and arts of a society; the growing of plants or cells
words.core_concept: what long tending finally brings up out of the ground – 长年照管之后，从地里长出来的那一片
words.core_image: 同一块地翻了几十年，长出来的东西跟别处就是不一样
examples: Each region has its own culture.
They grew a culture of bacteria.
semantic_expansions: 文化：世代照管养出来的那套风习
培养/栽培：照管使之长起来这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: cult（照管）+ -ure → 长年照管长出来的那一片

words.root_logic: creare（使生出）→ 把原先没有的做出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 creare（造出、使生出）的过去分词 creatus
words.native_definition: to make something exist that did not exist before
words.core_concept: the moment a thing first stands where nothing stood – 原先空着的那处，头一回有了东西
words.core_image: 纸上本来什么都没有，笔一落，一个形状就在那儿了
examples: She created a new design.
The storm created chaos.
semantic_expansions: 创造/创作：把原先没有的做出来
造成：某事使一个局面生出来
words.recall_hint: creare（使生出）→ 把原先没有的做出来

words.root_logic: create（使生出）+ -ive → 能把没有的弄出来的
words.origin: 英语 creative，来自 create ← 拉丁语 creare
words.native_definition: able to produce new and original things
words.core_concept: of the kind that turns an empty surface into something – 属于「能把空处变出东西」那一类
words.core_image: 同样一堆边角料，有人摆着摆着就成了个能用的东西
examples: She has a creative mind.
It was a creative solution.
semantic_expansions: 有创造力的/创造性的：能把原先没有的弄出来的那种
words.recall_hint: create（使生出）+ -ive → 能把没有的弄出来

words.root_logic: create（使生出）+ -ure → 被造出来的那个 → 生物
words.origin: 古法语 creature ← 晚期拉丁语 creatura（被造之物）← creare（造出）
words.native_definition: any living thing that can move, especially an animal
words.core_concept: whatever was brought into being and now moves on its own – 被弄出来、如今自己会动的那个
words.core_image: 石头下面那个小东西被光一照，八条腿一齐动起来
examples: Strange creatures live in the deep sea.
The poor creature was shivering.
semantic_expansions: 生物/动物：被造出来、自己会动的那个
家伙：带感情色彩地指某个人
words.recall_hint: create（使生出）+ -ure → 被造出来的那个

words.root_logic: crux（十字）→ 从一边横过到另一边，路线与原线相交
words.origin: 古英语 cros ← 古爱尔兰语 cros ← 拉丁语 crux（十字架）
words.native_definition: to go from one side to the other; a mark or shape of two lines
words.core_concept: the path that cuts through another instead of running alongside – 不顺着走，而是横切过去的那条线
words.core_image: 他从这边人行道横切过去，走线正好压过车道
examples: Look both ways before you cross.
Mark your answer with a cross.
semantic_expansions: 穿过：横切过另一条线
十字/交叉：两条线相交留下的那个形
words.recall_hint: crux（十字）→ 横切过去、与原线相交

words.root_logic: cruc（十字路口）+ -ial → 处在岔路交点上的 → 决定性的
words.origin: 拉丁语 crucialis（十字形的）← crux（十字架）；十字路口须择一路走，故引申为「决定成败的那一处」
words.native_definition: extremely important because it decides what follows
words.core_concept: the fork where the road splits and one must be chosen – 路在此分岔，非选一条不可的那一点
words.core_image: 路到这儿分成两条，选哪条后头就全不一样了
examples: This is a crucial decision.
Timing was crucial to the plan.
semantic_expansions: 决定性的/关键的：处在岔路交点、选择定成败的那一处
words.recall_hint: cruc（十字路口）+ -ial → 岔路交点、择一定成败

words.root_logic: crux（十字）→ 荷兰语 kruisen（打十字、来回横渡）→ 巡航
words.origin: 荷兰语 kruisen（十字形来回航行）← kruis（十字）← 拉丁语 crux
words.native_definition: to sail or drive at a steady pace without hurrying
words.core_concept: going back and forth across a stretch rather than straight to one end – 在一片水面上来回横着走，不直奔一头
words.core_image: 船不赶路，在同一片海面上来回划着走，速度一直没变
examples: The ship cruised along the coast.
We cruised at sixty miles an hour.
semantic_expansions: 巡航/巡游：来回横着走而不直奔一头
缓行：保持一个不赶的速度走
words.recall_hint: crux（十字）→ kruisen（来回横渡）→ 巡航

words.root_logic: datum（所给之物）的复数 → 摆出来供人处理的那些事实
words.origin: 拉丁语 data（datum 的复数，「所给之物」）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: facts and figures collected for reference or analysis
words.core_concept: the figures handed over for someone else to work on – 交到手上、让人拿去处理的那些数字
words.core_image: 一叠表格递过来，上面全是记好的数字，等着人去算
examples: The data shows a clear trend.
We collected data for six months.
semantic_expansions: 数据/资料：交到手上供人处理的那些事实与数字
words.recall_hint: datum（所给之物）的复数 → 供人处理的事实

words.root_logic: data（所给之物）+ base（底座）→ 把数据搁在一处的那个底盘
words.origin: 英语复合词 data＋base；data ← 拉丁语 dare（给）
words.native_definition: an organized store of information held in a computer
words.core_concept: the one place all the handed-over figures are kept – 把交上来的数字全搁在一处的那个地方
words.core_image: 所有表格最后都归到同一个柜里，查哪一份都能翻出来
examples: The database holds ten million records.
She queried the customer database.
semantic_expansions: 数据库：把交上来的数据统一搁在一处的那个地方
words.recall_hint: data（所给之物）+ base（底座）→ 存放数据的底盘

words.root_logic: datum（所给之物）→ 旧文书末尾写「datum Romae…（给于罗马某日）」→ 日期
words.origin: 古法语 date ← 晚期拉丁语 data（文书上标注的签发日）← dare（给）；旧时公文末尾以 datum（给于某地某日）起句，遂以此指日期
words.native_definition: the day of the month or year; an arrangement to meet
words.core_concept: the day written at the foot of a paper to fix when it was handed over – 写在文书末尾、标明何日交出的那一天
words.core_image: 信纸最下面一行写着地点和那一天，字迹比正文小些
examples: What is the date today?
They went on a date last night.
semantic_expansions: 日期：文书上标明何日交出的那一天
约会：定好在哪一天见面这件事
枣：另一支借自希腊 daktulos（指头），与本族无关
words.recall_hint: datum（给于某日）→ 文书末尾标注的那一天

words.root_logic: camera obscura（暗室）截短 → 靠一间暗室成像的那件器械
words.origin: 拉丁语 camera obscura（暗室）的截短形 ← camera（小室）← 希腊语 kamara（拱顶）
words.native_definition: a device for taking photographs or filming
words.core_concept: the light-tight box that lets in just one narrow beam – 密不透光的那个盒子，只放一束光进去
words.core_image: 盒子四面不透光，只前头留一个小孔，光从那儿进来
examples: He bought a new camera.
The camera stopped recording.
semantic_expansions: 照相机/摄像机：靠一间密闭暗室成像的那件器械
words.recall_hint: camera obscura（暗室）截短 → 成像的暗箱器械

words.root_logic: camera（小室）经古法语 chambre → 一间围起来的屋，也指枪膛、议院
words.origin: 古法语 chambre ← 拉丁语 camera（拱顶小室）
words.native_definition: a room, especially a private or official one; an enclosed space
words.core_concept: the space walled off so what is inside stays inside – 围起来、使里头的东西留在里头的那块空间
words.core_image: 推开厚门是一间不大的屋，声音在里头闷着传不出去
examples: The judge spoke in his chamber.
The gun has six chambers.
semantic_expansions: 房间：围起来的一间屋
议院：议事者聚在其中的那间
膛室：枪械里围起来装弹的那格
words.recall_hint: camera（小室）→ 围起来的一间屋

words.root_logic: camara（小室）→ 同住一室的人 → 同伴、战友
words.origin: 法语 camarade ← 西班牙语 camarada（同室者）← 拉丁语 camera（小室）
words.native_definition: a friend or fellow member, especially one sharing hardship
words.core_concept: the one who slept in the same small room as you – 跟你睡同一间小屋的那个人
words.core_image: 两张床挤在同一间屋里，夜里说话不用抬高声音
examples: He lost two comrades in the war.
She greeted her old comrades.
semantic_expansions: 同伴/战友：同住一室、共过患难的那个人
同志：以此互称的政治用法
words.recall_hint: camara（小室）→ 同住一室的人

words.root_logic: damnum（损失）+ -age → 受损这件事，及损到什么程度
words.origin: 古法语 damage（损失）← 拉丁语 damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: physical harm that makes something less useful or valuable
words.core_concept: what is gone from a thing and will not come back – 从一件东西上少掉、再补不回的那部分
words.core_image: 车头凹进去一块，钣金敲平了，那道折痕还留着
examples: The storm caused serious damage.
Water damaged the floor.
semantic_expansions: 损害/损坏：从物上少掉、补不回的那部分
损失：算总账时少掉的那一笔
words.recall_hint: damnum（损失）+ -age → 受损及其程度

words.root_logic: damnare（判罚）→ 判某人该受损失 → 谴责、诅咒
words.origin: 古法语 damner ← 拉丁语 damnare（判罚、使受损）← damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: to condemn strongly; used as a mild swear word
words.core_concept: handing down the verdict that a thing is to be written off – 一句话判定它就此作废
words.core_image: 他把那份稿子往桌上一推，一句话就断了它的生路
examples: Critics damned the film.
He damned his own bad luck.
semantic_expansions: 谴责：判定其该受损、就此作废
诅咒/该死的：把这道判词当骂语用
words.recall_hint: damnare（判罚）→ 判它该受损、就此作废

words.root_logic: con-（加强）+ demn（判罚）→ 正式判定其有罪或不堪用
words.origin: 拉丁语 condemnare（定罪）← con＋damnare（判罚）← damnum（损失）
words.native_definition: to express strong disapproval; to sentence; to declare unfit for use
words.core_concept: the formal word that settles a thing's fate against it – 一纸判词把它的去向定死
words.core_image: 楼门上钉了一张告示，写明此后不许住人
examples: They condemned the attack.
The building was condemned last year.
semantic_expansions: 谴责：正式表明不认可
判罪：判定其有罪
宣告不适用：判定房屋器物不堪再用
words.recall_hint: con-（加强）+ demn（判罚）→ 正式判定其不堪

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sta（立）→ constare（合起来立住、值多少）→ 代价
words.origin: 古法语 coster ← 拉丁语 constare（值、花费）← com＋stare（站立）
words.native_definition: the amount of money needed to buy or do something
words.core_concept: what has to be put up before a thing will stand – 要它立得住，先得垫上去的那份
words.core_image: 柜台上报出一个数，那数付了东西才归你
examples: The cost of living keeps rising.
It cost more than we expected.
semantic_expansions: 费用/花费：换取一物须付出的那个数
代价：不止钱，泛指须付出的那一份
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ sta（立）→ 要它立住须垫上的那份

words.root_logic: cost（代价）+ -ly（…样的）→ 代价大的
words.origin: 英语 costly，来自 cost ← 拉丁语 constare ← com＋stare
words.native_definition: expensive; causing much loss or harm
words.core_concept: the kind that takes a great deal to keep standing – 要撑住它得垫进去很多的那种
words.core_image: 那间铺子每月要垫进去的钱越来越多，最后关了门
examples: It was a costly mistake.
Repairs proved too costly.
semantic_expansions: 昂贵的/代价高的：要撑住它得垫进去很多的那种
words.recall_hint: cost（代价）+ -ly → 代价大的

words.root_logic: contra-（相对）+ sta（立）→ 两者对立而站 → 对比出的差别
words.origin: 法语 contraste ← 意大利语 contrastare（对立）← 拉丁语 contra＋stare（站立）
words.native_definition: a clear difference seen when two things are put side by side
words.core_concept: two things stood against each other so the gap shows – 两样对着立住，差别就显出来
words.core_image: 深浅两块布并排铺开，挨着一看才知道差多少
examples: The contrast between them is striking.
Her mood contrasts with his.
semantic_expansions: 对比/对照：两者对立而站、差别显出来
反差：那道差别本身的大小
words.recall_hint: contra-（相对）+ sta（立）→ 对着立住，差别显出

words.root_logic: capulum（套索）← capere（抓取）→ 抓得住东西的粗绳 → 缆
words.origin: 古北法语 cable ← 晚期拉丁语 capulum（套索）← 拉丁语 capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: a thick strong rope or bundle of wires
words.core_concept: the rope thick enough to hold whatever it is put around – 粗到能箍住东西不放的那种绳
words.core_image: 手腕粗的一股绞在一起，绕上桩子拽不动
examples: The cable snapped under strain.
They laid a cable under the sea.
semantic_expansions: 缆绳：粗到能箍住东西的那种绳
电缆：同样成股的导线
电报：靠海底电缆发的那种讯
words.recall_hint: capulum（套索）← capere（抓取）→ 抓得住的粗绳

words.root_logic: de-（脱开正道）+ ceit（接住）→ 让人接住假的 → 欺骗
words.origin: 古法语 deceite ← 拉丁语 decipere（诱骗）← de＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: the act of making someone believe what is not true
words.core_concept: handing over the false one so it is taken as real – 递过去一件假的，让人当真接下
words.core_image: 他把掺过的那壶推到客人手边，自己那壶另放着
examples: She was hurt by his deceit.
The scheme was built on deceit.
semantic_expansions: 欺骗/欺诈：递假的让人当真接下
谎言：用来骗人接下的那句话
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开正道）+ ceit（接住）→ 让人接住假的

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ cay（落）→ 一路往下落 → 衰败、腐烂
words.origin: 古北法语 decair ← 通俗拉丁语 decadere（落下去）← de＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: to become gradually worse or to rot away
words.core_concept: the slow slide downward that nothing stops – 一路往下掉，没什么拦住它
words.core_image: 木桩底下一年年发软，用手一掰就掉渣
examples: The wood began to decay.
The empire slowly decayed.
semantic_expansions: 腐烂：一路往下坏到掉渣
衰败/衰退：局面同样一路往下落
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ cay（落）→ 一路往下落

words.root_logic: caboche（大脑袋）← caput（头）→ 长成一个圆头的那种菜
words.origin: 古北法语 caboche（脑袋）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: a round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
words.core_concept: the vegetable that grows into one tight round head – 长成紧紧一个圆球的那种菜
words.core_image: 菜地里一颗颗圆球贴地摆着，叶子层层裹得很紧
examples: She shredded a whole cabbage.
Cabbage grows well in cool weather.
semantic_expansions: 卷心菜/甘蓝：叶子裹成紧紧一个圆头的那种菜
words.recall_hint: caboche（大脑袋）← caput（头）→ 长成圆头的菜

words.root_logic: consulere（商议、求教）→ 商议后给出的那番话 → 建议
words.origin: 古法语 conseil ← 拉丁语 consilium（商议、议事）← consulere（商议、求教）
words.native_definition: advice given after careful thought; a lawyer in a case
words.core_concept: what is said back after the matter has been talked through – 事情议过一遍之后回给你的那番话
words.core_image: 他把来龙去脉听完，沉了一会儿才开口说该怎么办
examples: She sought legal counsel.
He counselled patience.
semantic_expansions: 建议/劝告：议过之后回给你的那番话
律师：在案中受聘出这番话的人
words.recall_hint: consulere（商议）→ 议过之后回给你的话

words.root_logic: crescere（增多）→ crue（增补的人手）→ 一船一机上的那班人
words.origin: 古法语 crue（增补、增援）← creistre ← 拉丁语 crescere（生长、增多）
words.native_definition: the people who work on a ship, plane, or team
words.core_concept: the hands added until there are enough to work the vessel – 添到够用为止的那班人手
words.core_image: 船要开了还差几个人，码头上又叫来两个才凑齐
examples: The crew worked through the night.
A film crew arrived at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 船员/机组：添到够用、操作船机的那班人
全体人员：同一班人的总称
words.recall_hint: crescere（增多）→ crue（增补人手）→ 那班人

words.root_logic: de-（脱开）+ bt（habere 持有）→ debere（本该有却不在手上）→ 欠款
words.origin: 古法语 dette ← 拉丁语 debitum（所欠之物）← debere（欠）← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: money that one owes to another
words.core_concept: what should be in your hands but is not, because it is owed – 本该在手上、却因为欠着而不在的那份
words.core_image: 账本上写着数目，钱却还在别人那儿
examples: He paid off his debts.
The company is deep in debt.
semantic_expansions: 债务/欠款：本该在手上、因欠着而不在的那份
人情债：同样欠着、须回报的那一份
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开）+ habere（持有）→ 本该有却不在手上

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ leg（拣拢）→ colligere（收拢）→ 绕成一圈圈收起来
words.origin: 古法语 coillir（收拢）← 拉丁语 colligere（聚集）← com＋legere（拣选、拢起）
words.native_definition: a length of rope or wire wound into rings
words.core_concept: the rope gathered in on itself, ring lying on ring – 绳往自己身上收拢，一圈压一圈
words.core_image: 绳子一圈压一圈盘在甲板上，中间空出一个洞
examples: He hung a coil of rope on the hook.
The snake coiled around the branch.
semantic_expansions: 线圈/盘卷：绕成一圈圈收拢起来的那束
卷成圈：把它绕起来这个动作
words.recall_hint: col-（一起）+ leg（拣拢）→ 绕成一圈圈收起
